kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أوتمن (form VIII)
# أُوتَمَنُ (ʔūtamanu) /ʔuː.ta.ma.nu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِئْتَمَنَ (iʔtamana)
# أُوتَمَنَ (ʔūtamana) /ʔuː.ta.ma.na/: first-person singular non-past passive subjunctive of اِئْتَمَنَ (iʔtamana)
# أُوتَمَنْ (ʔūtaman) /ʔuː.ta.man/: first-person singular non-past passive jussive of اِئْتَمَنَ (iʔtamana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
